faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Engineer - Civil post at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The last date to email your application for the Junior Engineer - Civil position at IIEST Shibpur is 13th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer - Civil role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Engineer - Civil post will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, which is all-inclusive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Engineer - Civil position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with 2 years of experience or a First Class Diploma in Civil Engineering with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Engineer - Civil post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Engineer - Civil post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government Rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIEST Shibpur Junior Engineer - Civil recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Junior Engineer - Civil post?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 1000/-, and SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the walk-in interview date for the Junior Engineer - Civil position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Engineer - Civil position is scheduled for 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIEST Shibpur offer contractual positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Engineer - Civil position at IIEST Shibpur is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
